设计意图： Price impact per unit volume normalized by volatility (primary mechanism from parent2) adjusted by the downside/upside volatility ratio (lightweight modifier from parent1). The asymmetry ratio amplifies the price impact signal when downside volatility exceeds upside volatility, capturing regime-dependent liquidity costs. ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  4. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  5. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  6. 计算 avg_impact：impact.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
  8. 计算 factor：avg_impact / vol
  9. 计算 pos_ret：ret.where(ret > 0, 0.0)
  10. 计算 neg_ret：ret.where(ret < 0, 0.0)
  11. 计算 window：30
  12. 计算 vol_up：pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
  13. 计算 vol_down：neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1)
  14. 计算 ratio：vol_down / vol_up
  15. 计算 ratio：ratio
  16. 计算 factor：factor * (1.0 + ratio)
  17. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_asymmetry(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] ret = close.pct_change() abs_ret = ret.abs() impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) avg_impact = impact.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan) factor = avg_impact / vol pos_ret = ret.where(ret > 0, 0.0) neg_ret = ret.where(ret < 0, 0.0) window = 30 vol_up = pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1) vol_down = neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=int(window/2)).std(ddof=1) ratio = vol_down / vol_up.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor = factor * (1.0 + ratio) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_asymmetry'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_asymmetry']
